items.name: Bolivia Cubing Tour - Sucre 2025
items.information:
**The Bolivia Cubing Tour Sucre 2025** will be the second competition of an exciting tour that will take place **in four different cities across Bolivia, between January 19 and 26**. This will be the perfect opportunity for competitors from all over the country to join a unique speedcubing experience, enjoying thrilling tournaments in various locations.
This competition is open to all public. To see all the information about register payment go to the next [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaCubingTourSucre2025#53004-informacion-de-pago-payment-information)

**More information about the competitions enter to: [Frequently Asked Questions / FAQ]      (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaCubingTourSucre2025#53001-faq-pmf)**

**El Bolivia Cubing Tour Sucre 2025** será la segunda competencia de un emocionante tour que se llevará a cabo en **cuatro ciudades diferentes de Bolivia, entre el 19 y el 26 de enero**. Esta será la oportunidad perfecta para los competidores de todo el país de unirse a una experiencia única de speedcubing, disfrutando de emocionantes torneos en distintas localidades.
Esta competencia esta abierta a todo publico. Para ver la informacion acerca del pago de inscripcion entra al siguiente [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaCubingTourSucre2025#53004-informacion-de-pago-payment-information)

**Mas informacion acerca de las competencias ingresar a: [Preguntas frecuentes / FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaCubingTourSucre2025#53001-faq-pmf)**
